query:
SELECT a.id, a.cobrancaId, a.status as acordoStatus, COUNT(p.id) as numParcelas 
FROM acordos a 
LEFT JOIN parcelasAcordo p ON a.id = p.acordoId 
WHERE a.cobrancaId = 30001 
GROUP BY a.id;
